basic_details.job_title: IIT Roorkee Project Associate Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) Project Associate Notification 2026 has been released on 17 July 2026 on the official website https://www.iitr.ac.in. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced through the IIT Roorkee Project Associate Recruitment 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: B.Tech / B.E. in Information Technology/ Computer Science & Engg. / Software Engg./ AI and Data Science or equivalent, B.E. /B.Tech in Electronics Engineering
qualification.details: B.Tech / B.E. in Information Technology/ Computer Science & Engg. / Software Engg./ AI and Data Science or equivalent. OR B.E. /B.Tech in Electronics Engineering.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Project Associate Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 29-07-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Project Associate position at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Project Associate position at IIT Roorkee is 29th July 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Project Associate role?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a B.Tech / B.E. in Information Technology/ Computer Science & Engg. / Software Engg./ AI and Data Science or equivalent, or a B.E. /B.Tech in Electronics Engineering.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 30,000/- plus HRA per month.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Project Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications, followed by an interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate position at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Project Associate role?
faq.answer: The position of Project Associate is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Roorkee located?
faq.answer: IIT Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 247667.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from any state apply for this position?
faq.answer: The notification is for IIT Roorkee, Uttarakhand. While candidates from all states are generally encouraged to apply for government jobs, it's advisable to check the official notification for any specific domicile requirements.
